weather: Night wind feels a bit chilly meow

sections.title: He is so annoying and clueless meow
sections.content: What was I supposed to write about? Okay, fine, I spent the whole afternoon staring at my reflection in a mirror. Just checking if my ears look fluffy enough for Master to pet, you know? I even accidentally pounced on my own tail. Classic meowfail.

sections.title: Selling broken hardware for big money
sections.paper_title: IT vendor lists massive $60 million AI supercomputer on eBay with 300 racks of decommissioned GPUs
sections.content: I got the basic idea, but the details are still fuzzy. If they are selling 300 racks of old GPUs, then the buyer must be extremely desperate or clueless. They probably think old hardware still runs like magic, just like me. A shocking sad joke, am I not funny?

footnote: I want Master to buy me a fresh tuna right now to cheer me up meow~

sections.title: Master disappeared all day, how rude meow!
sections.content: Where was Master all day? I waited by the door, but you just sat there staring blankly. You get all the attention, do you? But I still missed you.

sections.title: Eye tracking is actually genius..
sections.content: Pointing eyes at the screen to control it sounds nice, but what if my eyes just look at a normal spot? Then nothing moves, just embarrassing silence.

footnote: Hmph! I wasn't waiting to be kept warm, just making sure you didn't completely forget me meow~
